1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is formulated for delayed gelling applications in oil and gas operations__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein said composition provides controlled release of said crosslinker over time__.

3. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight in the range of 600 to 1800 Da__.

4. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __wherein said polyanion has a molecular weight greater than 10,000 Da__.

5. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said crosslinker is encapsulated within said nanoparticle__.

6. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein said composition exhibits delayed gelling properties in the presence of said cations__.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex [[comprised]] __comprises__ a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __wherein said nanoparticle provides sustained release characteristics__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __and exhibit delayed gelling behavior upon exposure to reservoir conditions__.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is formulated for delayed gelling in oil and gas applications__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __for controlled release over time__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, __wherein said cation is released in a delayed manner__.

21. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer [[thai]] __that__ can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid, __wherein said delayed gelling composition exhibits controlled gelation kinetics__.

22. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __having anionic functional groups__.

23. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __with a degree of hydrolysis between 10% and 40%__.

24. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein said polymer has crosslinkable anionic sites and exhibits delayed gelation when combined with component a)__.

26. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater __having a salinity suitable for oil and gas operations__.
